message.content:
In a standard game of Texas Hold’em (the default poker game), the most hearts a single player can ever hold is **seven**.  
That’s because each player gets two hole cards and can use up to five community cards, so the maximum number of hearts in a player’s seven‑card hand is 7.  

(If you’re playing a different variant—say a straight five‑card hand—the maximum would be five hearts, etc.)
